worlds.notes: Rebirth states outright that separate worlds exist and part again (chapter 14). Whether the Remake ending, INTERmission's post-credits scene and Rebirth's interlude all show one and the same branch is treated as one world until a title distinguishes them. The branch point (Zack's last stand) is not recorded yet: in the original it is shown only visually, in an optional flashback, and still needs checking against footage.
